When you buy Appspace, you get access to the entire platform, but pricing is based on what you need right now. Once you’re up and running, it’s easy to add users and devices. ## Users and devices: How pricing works ##### USERS How many users do you have? Users are people who will access Appspace to get news and updates, reserve meeting rooms and desks, and pre-register visitors. Admins are free. For now, just estimate how many unique users you’ll need. ##### DEVICES How many devices will be running? Devices are the screens that you want to use to display information: your TV screens, digital signs, room booking panels, and visitor and wayfinding kiosks. For now, just estimate how many of your devices you’d like to display Appspace content. For full terms of the Service Level Agreement, click [here](https://www.appspace.com/legal/sla/) Other services may be available for a fee through a partner or Appspace Professional Services # Below is a breakdown of service definitions Network Assessment Upon customer completing a network questionnaire, an Appspace Engineer uses an Environment Check Tool to assess the network, find incorrect settings and work with customer to rectify. Estimate: 8 hours. On-Prem Software Installation An Appspace engineer uses remote desktop tools to supervise, help or perform the installation of Appspace on-premises software on a customer’s server. Pre-requisite requires a successful Network Consult. Estimate: 8 hours. Custom Channel Design Appspace Professional Services will work with customer to design, and build a custom channel using the visual editor toolset, as defined in the Standard Statement of Work. Estimate: 40 hours. Device Task Templates & Configuration An Appspace engineer uses a pre-built template or creates a new one to configure a device task. Customer is responsible for applying task templates to specific devices. Estimate: 120mins/template. Alert Templates & Configuration Appspace Professional Services will work with customer to tailor an existing alert template. Estimate: 60 mins/template. ## Manage your entire workplace. Pay for what you need. You’ll find our pricing for solutions is competitive, but we offer a lot more options and flexibility as your needs change. These options are designed to tailor the Appspace platform to your specific business needs. ### Premium content Bring your internal comms to life. Choose from our ready-made, award-winning content and templates. ### More devices You only pay for the media players, collaboration endpoints, and scheduling devices you’re using to run Appspace. As you grow and add more end points, simply purchase additional device licenses. ### More users You only pay for the people who will be using Appspace to get news and updates or make reservations. It’s easy to add more Premium Users if you need to. Admins are always free. ### Enhanced services Need custom content or integrations? Training? We’ve got you. Our Enhanced Services team is here to help you get more from Appspace. ### Upgrade your support Our Customer Success team is ready to help when you need it, but if you’d like more, it’s easy to scale up. ### Frontline Worker Comms Built for the deskless workforce. Bundles an AI-powered mobile app, intranet, and digital signage with a dedicated onboarding service — so your team is connected from day one. **[Learn more ›](https://www.appspace.com/frontline-workers/)** ## Pricing FAQs Have questions? Here are the most common ones, with answers. **How does Appspace Free work?** Sign up for a free account online and then share information with 1 compatible device, invite 2 Premium Users, and register up to 2 Admins. You also get 5GB storage and 5GB/mo. of bandwidth. **How many users can view content?** Everyone in an organization can view content through digital signage on workplace displays or through enterprise messaging apps. Only Premium Users can view content in the Employee App (content portal). To view content in the Employee App, the account must be configured for Single Sign-On with Just-in-time user creation. To create and manage content and the account, Admin users must be registered. **What’s the difference between Admin and Premium Users?** An Admin (also known as a Platform User) is a user that manages technical, brand or account aspects. Admins in an organization will typically be IT or facilities management. A Premium User is any person that you give access to the Employee App to view content and make reservations. **Can I buy individual device IDs?** Yes! It’s easy to add device IDs if you’ve got a paid subscription. You can’t buy device IDs if you’ve got Appspace Free. **Can I buy additional storage and bandwidth?** Yes! You can add extra cloud storage for $0.10/GB/mo. and you can add bandwidth for $0.15/GB/mo. You can add these to any paid subscription, but not if you’ve got Appspace Free. **Are there educational discounts?** Yes. Please **[contact us](https://www.appspace.com/contact)** to find out more. ## Ready to get started?
